lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi CR7-A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> Tascam Hi-Res Editor (24/96 .wav) > Adobe Audition CC 2022 > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Great and unique first‑set Truckin' jam captured on an unknown‑source recording of solid quality
ai_review.review: The show features a memorable Truckin’ as the first‑set closer, with Jerry launching into an aggressive jam that keeps listeners hooked. Bob’s quirky vocal refrain adds character, while Playin’ offers a nice exploratory stretch; the overall performance is praised despite noting that other 1982 China Dolls sound better.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review gives 4 stars, highlighting strong musical moments and no major recording complaints, leading to a solid but cautiously estimated rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on sound quality; reviewer’s positive tone suggests the audio is listenable with no noticeable flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual first‑set close with Truckin', followed by a high‑energy jam and a quirky vocal finish; overall flow is praised for its uniqueness.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Launches a full‑frontal attack in the Truckin' jam, delivering strong guitar energy.
band_member_comments.Bob: Provides an odd vocal refrain that drops out rather than snapping to a clean ending.
